GW-FAC-SUB-01.role: Relay undervoltage threshold changed 0.88 to 0.94 pu at D-3 17:00Z; trips at 07:12Z on D0 adding about 24,000 customers to the storm outage. First drone sortie target (D-10).

GW-FAC-SUB-02.role: Breaker-open command to CB-7 at D+7 14:30Z (8,400 customers); final restoration D+35. Follow-up inspection flagged by the FEMA survey (PUB-112). False 'trapped survivor' calls cluster around it D+7 to D+10.

GW-FAC-SUB-03.role: Breaker-open at D+10 19:45Z (6,800 customers; backup feed to the water plant pump room lost); restored D+35.

GW-FAC-SUB-04.role: Not operated maliciously; a relay configuration timestamp of D-3 was later found on its RTU.

GW-FAC-DSS-01.role: Feeder substation for Shoreline Regional Medical Center. Storm outage from 06:17Z D0; restored 09:14 local D+8. It is not one of the five transmission substations, which is why the hospital stays on commercial power when SUB-02 and SUB-03 are opened. Named in influence-operation posts on D0 (EVT-1504).
GW-FAC-DSS-01.decision: Alias resolved 2026-11-09: 69/12.5 kV distribution substation fed from Bayside (SUB-05).

GW-FAC-OPS-01.role: Workstation GW-WS-OPS-02 here issued the D+7 breaker command with no operator logged in.

_placement.note: Substation street addresses come from the thread designs (EVT-1901, EVT-1707, old registry); each asset is placed beside that real road. The designs' own coordinates (for example 27.8041N 97.3975W for 'Harbor View area') pre-date the real geography and are superseded.

P-3 discharge setpoint lowered 85 to 68 psi at D+8 21:00 local and restored D+28; P-2 back D+38; certified at full capacity D+42.

EQP-1102.role: P-2: vibration trend from D-55, fails at D0, parts ordered D+2 from SUP-0219 (quoted 9 days, arrive D+36), restored D+38.

EQP-1103.role: P-3: overheats at D0; target of the D+8 setpoint change.

EQP-1104.role: P-4 loses supply when SUB-03 opens at D+10 (Zone 4 falls to 14 psi).

FAC-UTL-02.role: Both feeds fail at D0; the backup feed is lost again when SUB-03 opens at D+10. Hardening planned at D+110.

_pressure_test_points.note: Canon says Zone 4 pressure is above 40 psi 'at all test points' on D+42 but does not list them; six points are defined on real streets inside Districts 3 and 4.
